days.title: Geological Features and Peaks
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: höchster Punkt
stops.detail: Its highest point is 86 meters above sea level.

stops.name: Granitklippen
stops.detail: The island consists of large, bouldery areas and granite cliffs polished by ice.

stops.name: Granithöhlen
stops.detail: The impressive granite caves on Blå Jungfrun are glacier pots, which are referred to as jättegrytor ("giant's kettles").

days.title: Northern and Southern Landscapes
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: nördliche Teil
stops.detail: While the northern part is rugged and barren, the southern area is flatter and covered with deciduous forest.

stops.name: Labyrinth
stops.detail: At the southern tip of the island there is a labyrinth in the form of a stone setting (trojeborgen, Troy Town).
